_doc: Corpus-expansion fetch list — the vetted public-data sources to pull onto the Cost Index open-data engine. Product of the 2026-07-24 scout/verify workflow (verdict ship-with-fixes; four access/license mislabels corrected and applied here). Per ADR-013 the LIVE fetch runs on the operator Mac (keys + network); the container builds each adapter with a --demo/fixture mode + honest-subset gate, and the surface that consumes it. Every source routes to the cost-intelligence funnel; nothing touches the retired/frozen surfaces, and nothing enters the measured tier or the Vendor Benchmark reference.

status_legend.ready: keyless + verified — an adapter can fetch it now (operator Mac)
status_legend.park: endpoint real but blocked on a credential the operator must request first
status_legend.context-only: goes into sourced-claims prose (dispatch), NEVER an /open series or a pressure input

waves.name: Keyless recall event feeds
waves.why: highest on-funnel leverage, zero new UI — dated documented events straight into the ADR-011 co-occurrence surface

waves.name: Keyed event feed
waves.why: same events lane, a beat later once the credential is pulled

waves.name: Descriptive backdrops (labor / demand / packaging+freight)
waves.why: fenced-off new lanes — the ~30% of the plate the food index is silent on; strictly descriptive, kept out of the index/pressure/VB

waves.name: Nutrient multiplier
waves.why: a CC0 composition constant × existing prices+yields → a derived CC-BY $/g-protein layer

waves.name: World supply
waves.why: non-US production/stocks/exports behind imported items; email-keyed adapters

waves.name: Context-only (forecast / stated / statutory)
waves.why: quarantined to sourced-claims prose; the risk here is the honesty boundary, not access

sources.name: openFDA Food Enforcement (recalls)
sources.key_note: optional free api.data.gov key only raises rate limits
sources.adds: Dated recall events (reason, class, firm, distribution states) for produce/seafood/dairy/spices/nuts.
sources.honesty_guard: Co-occurrence only on the ADR-011 events surface — an event flag/count beside a price window, never an asserted cause or magnitude; direction only where it agrees with directionExpected.

sources.name: USDA FSIS Recall & Public Health Alert API
sources.adds: The meat/poultry/egg half openFDA excludes — recalls + PHAs (product, establishment, reason, states, dates).
sources.honesty_guard: Same co-occurrence framing as openFDA; pairs with it so the recall lane spans both jurisdictions without double-claiming an event.

sources.name: FDA Import Refusals (Data Dashboard API)
sources.key_note: AUDIT FIX: NOT keyless (bare endpoint → 403). Requires Authorization-User + Authorization-Key from the OII Unified Logon (manual approval); a distinct credential from BLS/Census/data.gov keys. Also confirm whether the monthly Import Refusal Report bulk files give a truly keyless path.
sources.adds: Refused-entry lines by product × country × charge — turns the Census origin-HHI already in the ISR into a live risk read.
sources.honesty_guard: Co-occurrence event lane; a refusal is a documented border event, never an asserted price cause.

sources.name: BLS QCEW — county avg weekly wage (NAICS 722/7225)
sources.adds: County restaurant-industry avg weekly wage + employment — opens the labor slice the food index is silent on.
sources.honesty_guard: Separate LABOR lane, descriptive tier — never blended into the food index, the pressure math, or the Vendor Benchmark reference.

sources.name: Census MARTS — Food Services & Drinking Places sales
sources.key_note: free key, may be held; FRED mirror series RSFSDP/RSFSDPN needs no key
sources.adds: Monthly NAICS 722 top-line = the sell-side / pricing-power backdrop the corpus lacks.
sources.honesty_guard: Observed sales, not a demand forecast; the advance estimate is labeled provisional; never fed into the pressure math.

sources.name: USDA FoodData Central
sources.key_note: AUDIT FIX: source nutrient constants from Foundation Foods + SR Legacy (clean CC0), NOT the contributor-supplied Branded subset; bulk download at fdc.nal.usda.gov/download-datasets
sources.adds: Nutrient composition/100g × existing price levels + edible yields → $/g-protein, $/calorie, cost-per-nutrient rankings.
sources.honesty_guard: A composition constant, not a price; the derived $/nutrient output is OUR deterministic recompute (published CC-BY 'Muntin Digital' per ADR-015), never a market level.

sources.name: BLS OEWS — occupation × metro wage
sources.key_note: OEUM… series; cooks 35-2014, servers 35-3031, dishwashers 35-9021, supervisors 35-1012; Washington-Arlington-Alexandria MSA. Bulk file bls.gov/oes/current/oes_msa.htm
sources.adds: Per-role wage (mean + percentiles) — the cut QCEW's industry average can't give.
sources.honesty_guard: Separate LABOR lane; an annual point-in-time snapshot labeled lagged ~1yr — descriptive backdrop, not a wholesale level.

sources.name: BLS PPI — packaging & non-food leaves
sources.key_note: WPU commodity series — corrugated/fiber boxes, plastics film, foil, foam, nitrile gloves, cleaning compounds, CO2. PIN the exact WPU codes before shipping (never a guessed code).
sources.adds: Off-premise / operating-cost backdrop distinct from the food commodities.
sources.honesty_guard: Separate PACKAGING lane, descriptive; never blended into the food index or pressure math.

sources.name: BLS PPI — long-distance / refrigerated TL trucking
sources.key_note: PPI industry series PCU484121… — confirm the exact series ID before shipping
sources.adds: The freight rate distinct from the wired EIA diesel input — 'fuel, or the trucking market tightening?'
sources.honesty_guard: Separate FREIGHT lane, descriptive; sits beside (not inside) the diesel driver.

sources.name: USDA NASS — Catfish & Trout + Census of Aquaculture
sources.key_note: confirm commodity_desc=CATFISH/TROUT; Census-of-Aquaculture bulk tables for shrimp/salmon/tilapia farmed fundamentals
sources.adds: US farmed-seafood fundamentals the wild-landings (NOAA) + customs unit-value (Census) pair can't see.
sources.honesty_guard: Honest subset per ADR-013 — never the measured tier or the VB reference; a production fundamental, not a price.

sources.name: USDA FAS — PSD Online
sources.key_note: AUDIT FIX: key is NOT self-serve — request by emailing psdonline@fas.usda.gov; passed in a non-standard header named API_KEY (not a data.gov api_key query param). Confirm whether GATS/ESR share this credential/host before treating them as one adapter.
sources.adds: Country-level area/yield/production/stocks-to-use for non-US/world supply of imported produce, coffee, sugar, oils, beef.
sources.honesty_guard: Settled marketing-year rows descriptive; forward-year rows attributed context-only, never a forecast in our voice.

sources.name: USDA FAS — Export Sales Reporting (ESR)
sources.key_note: confirm the ESR endpoint + commodity list share the FAS_KEY/host with PSD (OpendataWeb v2)
sources.adds: Weekly US export commitments (beef, pork, grains/oils) — cadence matches the weekly dispatch.
sources.honesty_guard: A documented weekly commitment, co-occurrence with domestic protein windows — never an asserted supply-tightening cause.

sources.name: USDA WASDE
sources.adds: Monthly ending stocks, stocks-to-use, USDA's own season-avg farm-price range.
sources.honesty_guard: CONTEXT-ONLY: this is USDA's forecast — cited in dispatch prose as USDA's number, NEVER an /open series and NEVER a pressure input; the fact gate keeps it out of our own voice.

sources.name: SEC EDGAR — distributor & chain filings
sources.key_note: AUDIT FIX: numeric XBRL facts are public-domain and OK; the filer's MD&A NARRATIVE is authored text — extract numbers + short attributed quotes ('Sysco reported product cost inflation of X%'), NEVER republish MD&A prose as an /open series.
sources.adds: Broadliner gross-margin trend (Sysco/USFD/PFGC) + stated product-cost inflation by category.
sources.honesty_guard: CONTEXT-ONLY, numbers-not-narrative: numeric facts + short attributed quotes in dispatch prose; never a republished series.

sources.name: USITC — HTS tariff schedule (+ DataWeb)
sources.key_note: HTS export JSON/CSV no key; DataWeb (datawebws.usitc.gov) needs a free token — PARK
sources.adds: Column-1 duty rates + scheduled/Section-301 changes by HTS — turns origin-HHI into a cost-risk flag.
sources.honesty_guard: CONTEXT-ONLY: a duty-rate schedule (a published fact), cited in prose; never blended into the measured tier.

sources.name: USBR RISE — reservoir storage
sources.key_note: map per-reservoir IDs to growing regions (CA Central Valley, Colorado River)
sources.adds: Reservoir storage vs 30-yr avg — water-supply backdrop behind produce, tree nuts, cattle liquidation.
sources.honesty_guard: CONTEXT-ONLY backdrop, co-occurrence with growing regions; never an asserted price cause or forecast.

sources.name: MD + Montgomery County statutory min/tipped wage schedule
sources.key_note: HTML/PDF, manual upkeep, no API; the wage floor is law, stepping every July 1, CPI-indexed
sources.adds: A rare forward-SCHEDULED, non-forecast number — the wage floor is law, not a prediction.
sources.honesty_guard: A statutory schedule (a published legal fact), cited in prose; the one 'forward' number allowed because it is enacted law, not a forecast.
